frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Liquidating a large position optimally is a control problem balancing impact cost against price risk over a fixed window; a running inventory penalty sets urgency, bending the schedule from a TWAP straight line toward convex front-loading.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Almgren-Chriss Optimal Execution: Temporary vs Permanent Impact and the Urgency Trade-off
